name: YandexMobileBot
description: Yandex's mobile-layout robot, which fetches pages to determine whether their layout is suitable for mobile devices. It advertises an iPhone Safari prefix followed by its own YandexMobileBot token, and Yandex lists it among the robots that do not follow the general robots.txt rules written for arbitrary robots.

instances: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 8_1 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/600.1.4 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/8.0 Mobile/12B411 Safari/600.1.4 (compatible; YandexMobileBot/3.0; +http://yandex.com/bots)
